title: Office plants: more than decoration
text: It would be easy to assume that office plants are {{1}} there to look nice. In fact, research shows that greenery in the workplace measurably improves both concentration {{2}} wellbeing. One study found that employees {{3}} desks contained plants were 15 per cent more productive than those working in bare offices. Plants also absorb sound, reducing the background noise {{4}} makes open-plan offices so exhausting. Even a small plant on a windowsill can make people {{5}} calmer, perhaps because we respond positively {{6}} anything natural. So if your employer refuses {{7}} invest in greenery, why not bring {{8}} your own? Your colleagues may thank you for it.
